outcome: Diffusion-tensor imaging (DTI) along the PVS (DTI-ALPS) index values
cohort: The study included 127 neonates from a single institution whose brain MRI scans were collected.
finding: Neonates with hypoxic-ischemic injury (HII) demonstrated significantly smaller basal ganglia perivascular space (BG-PVS) volume and fraction compared to those without HII, while DTI-ALPS index values did not differ significantly.
cross-section timing: MRI scans were collected between July 2020 and July 2022.
birth_weight: Adjusted for in multivariable logistic regression.
gest_age: Median gestational age (GA) was 252 days (approximately 36 weeks) for both HII and non-HII groups.
